probes.label: determine-locales-receives-locales
probes.php: t([]) with a recording resolver; get('g.a')

probes.label: determine-locales-receives-duplicates
probes.php: t([], 'en', 'en') with a recording resolver; get('g.a')

probes.label: determine-locales-adds-locale
